theme: Peak-summer Italian — one slow tomato sugo that carries the whole week

components.name: Slow tomato sofrito (sugo)
components.ingredients: 3 lb ripe tomatoes (or 2 cans San Marzano + the best fresh you have), 1 onion, 4 garlic cloves, generous olive oil, basil stems, pinch of chili, salt
components.method: Sweat finely diced onion in a good pour of olive oil until jammy, add garlic, then crushed tomatoes and basil stems. Simmer low 45–60 min until reduced and glossy. Cool. Keeps 5 days in the fridge and freezes well — the backbone of three dinners below.

components.name: Marinated summer beans & zucchini
components.ingredients: 1 lb green or wax beans, 2 zucchini, lemon, olive oil, garlic, mint or basil
components.method: Blanch beans crisp-tender; grill or blister the zucchini. While still warm, toss with lemon, olive oil, a smashed garlic clove, and torn herbs. Holds 4 days and becomes salads, pasta add-ins, or a quick side.

dinners.name: Spaghetti al pomodoro, done right
dinners.ingredients: sofrito, spaghetti, basil, Parmigiano, olive oil
steps: Boil pasta 1 min shy of al dente.
Warm the sofrito, loosen with pasta water.
Finish the pasta in the sauce 60–90 sec.
Off heat: torn basil + a thread of olive oil.
Cheese at the table.

dinners.name: Pan-seared fish with sofrito & beans
dinners.ingredients: 2 fillets firm white fish or salmon, sofrito, the marinated beans, lemon
steps: Pat fish very dry, salt well.
Sear skin-side down in olive oil until crisp.
Spoon warm sofrito onto the plates.
Set fish on top, beans alongside.
Bright squeeze of lemon.

dinners.name: Summer vegetable & sofrito gratin
dinners.ingredients: zucchini, eggplant, sofrito, breadcrumbs, Parmigiano, olive oil
steps: Layer sliced zucchini and eggplant with sofrito.
Season each layer, drizzle with oil.
Top with Parmigiano breadcrumbs.
Bake 375°F ~35 min until bubbling.
Rest 10 min before serving.

dinners.name: Clams (or mussels) in brothy sofrito
dinners.ingredients: 2 lb clams or mussels, sofrito thinned with white wine, parsley, grilled bread
steps: Bloom garlic and chili in olive oil.
Add a ladle of sofrito + a splash of wine.
Add shellfish, cover, steam until open.
Parsley; discard any that stayed shut.
Serve with grilled bread for the broth.

technique.name: Emulsifying pasta sauce with starchy water
technique.tiedTo: Spaghetti al pomodoro — the swirl that makes it glossy and clinging, not watery.

shopping.items: ripe tomatoes (3 lb), onion, garlic, 2 zucchini, 1 eggplant, green/wax beans (1 lb), basil, mint, parsley, lemons
2 firm white fish or salmon fillets; 2 lb clams or mussels
San Marzano tomatoes (2 cans, backup), spaghetti, breadcrumbs, good olive oil, dried chili, white wine

scaleNote: For the weeks the four girls are here (6 people): double the sofrito and pasta, add a second fish fillet or stretch with more beans, and set aside a plain buttered-pasta + mild-sofrito portion before you add chili. The gratin scales straight up in a bigger dish.
